install_steps: Or download the pwru binary for your platform from https://github.com/cilium/pwru/releases
Requires Linux kernel >= 5.4 with BTF and root privileges
note: pwru must run as root (CAP_BPF/CAP_SYS_ADMIN) and needs kernel BTF — check /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux exists. Linux-only. It attaches kprobes to kernel networking functions; use --filter-* flags to keep the event volume manageable on busy systems.
